g.text: Host-level periodicity: many candidates, a credible few

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #333333
font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #333333

g.text: n = 1,761 host-by-block series with at least 30 seconds of data; 1,096 pass Benjamini-Hochberg at q<0.05. The shaded band marks 2-60 s, where a

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #6b6b6b

g.text: heartbeat would live. Shuffling is a weak null for bursty traffic, so the credible set is the low-CV, high-peak corner, not the whole blue cloud.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #6b6b6b

g.text: Source: cap_20260920_111416/112321/112821/113321.pcap (4 files, 17.2 min; two continuous blocks of 192 s and 842 s). One-way byte convention; loopback

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #6b6b6b

g.text: and non-IP traffic are handled per the data-convention note. Time-based statements are limited to those two blocks.
